nodes.summary: Read a UTF-8 RFC 4180 file with encoding/csv into a header and data records.
nodes.instructions:
The first record is the header. Quoted commas stay in one value. Bytes that are not valid UTF-8
are not a rejection condition. Do not enable encoding/csv field-count checking here; ragged
detection is a separate story.
nodes.name: Read a UTF-8 RFC 4180 file with encoding/csv into a header and data records.

nodes.summary: Trim header names and values and classify null values.
nodes.instructions:
Trim leading and trailing spaces from every header name and value before any other rule. A value
is null when empty or equal to NA, N/A, or NULL ignoring case.
nodes.name: Trim header names and values and classify null values.

nodes.summary: Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.
nodes.instructions:
An open or read error exits 1 with nothing on standard output and one stderr diagnostic naming
the file.
nodes.name: Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.

nodes.summary: Count rows, nulls, and distinct non-null values per column.
nodes.instructions:
rows is the number of data records, nulls the number of null values, distinct the number of
different non-null values compared as exact trimmed strings.
nodes.name: Count rows, nulls, and distinct non-null values per column.

nodes.summary: Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records with exit 3.
nodes.instructions:
Exit 3, write nothing to standard output, and write one diagnostic naming the file and the line
of a rejected record to standard error.
nodes.name: Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records with exit 3.

nodes.summary: Parse --column, --freq, --top, and the single file argument.
nodes.instructions:
Options precede exactly one file argument. --top defaults to 5. Parsing yields a request value
that the profile and frequency stories consume.
nodes.name: Parse --column, --freq, --top, and the single file argument.

nodes.summary: Profile only the column named by --column, rejecting an absent name with exit 3.
nodes.instructions:
Match trimmed header names exactly and case-sensitively. A name absent from the header exits 3
with nothing on standard output.
nodes.name: Profile only the column named by --column, rejecting an absent name with exit 3.

nodes.summary: Reject usage errors with exit 2 and both synopses on standard error.
nodes.instructions:
Exit 2 with nothing on standard output for a missing or extra file, an unknown option (including
--help and -h), a missing option value, a --top that is not a positive integer, --top without
--freq, and --column with --freq. Write both synopses to standard error.
nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit 2 and both synopses on standard error.

nodes.summary: Infer integer, number, boolean, text, and empty column types.
nodes.instructions:
A column takes the first matching type among integer, number, date, boolean, text that every
non-null value satisfies; a column with no non-null value is empty. Boolean ignores case. The date
check is supplied by the date-type story and is a hook that defaults to no match here.
nodes.name: Infer integer, number, boolean, text, and empty column types.

nodes.summary: Recognize date columns with real calendar validation.
nodes.instructions:
A value is a date only when it matches YYYY-MM-DD and is a real calendar date, so 2025-02-30 is
not. One non-date value makes the column fall to the next matching type.
nodes.name: Recognize date columns with real calendar validation.

nodes.summary: List the most frequent non-null values of a column with --freq.
nodes.instructions:
Order by count descending, then value ascending by byte value, at most --top rows (default 5).
Null values are not listed. A column with no non-null values writes only the header. An absent
column name exits 3.
nodes.name: List the most frequent non-null values of a column with --freq.

nodes.summary: Compute min and max per column type.
nodes.instructions:
Integer: smallest and largest as integers. Number: decimals with two places. Date: earliest and
latest. Boolean: min is false if any value is false; max is true if any value is true. Text: byte
order. Empty: blank. Compute with exact arithmetic, never floats.
nodes.name: Compute min and max per column type.

nodes.summary: Compute exact sum, mean, and median for integer and number columns.
nodes.instructions:
Use math/big exact values and round once, half away from zero, when writing. Integer sum is a
plain integer; number sum is two places; mean and median are two places for both types. Median is
the middle value, or the mean of the two middle values for an even count. Other types leave these
fields empty.
nodes.name: Compute exact sum, mean, and median for integer and number columns.

nodes.summary: Write profile and frequency output as CSV with newline line endings.
nodes.instructions:
Profile header is column,type,rows,nulls,distinct,min,max,sum,mean,median, one row per column in
file order. Frequency header is value,count. Use encoding/csv with UseCRLF false. A failing
command writes nothing to standard output, so buffer output and write only on success.
nodes.name: Write profile and frequency output as CSV with newline line endings.

nodes.summary: Provide bin/test.sh running go vet and go test from the application root.
nodes.instructions:
Write bin/test.sh in POSIX sh. It changes to the application root, runs go vet ./... then
go test ./..., and exits zero only when both pass.
nodes.name: Provide bin/test.sh running go vet and go test from the application root.

nodes.summary: Prove the application root builds csvstat with go build using only the standard library.
nodes.instructions:
Ensure go.mod declares no requirements and that go build ./cmd/csvstat produces a runnable
executable on the host platform with no runtime dependency beyond the binary.
nodes.name: Prove the application root builds csvstat with go build using only the standard library.

nodes.summary: Read a UTF-8 RFC 4180 file with encoding/csv into a header and data records.
nodes.instructions:
The first record is the header. Quoted commas stay in one value. Bytes that are not valid UTF-8
are not a rejection condition. Do not enable encoding/csv field-count checking here; ragged
detection is a separate story.
nodes.name: Read a UTF-8 RFC 4180 file with encoding/csv into a header and data records.

nodes.summary: Trim header names and values and classify null values.
nodes.instructions:
Trim leading and trailing spaces from every header name and value before any other rule. A value
is null when empty or equal to NA, N/A, or NULL ignoring case.
nodes.name: Trim header names and values and classify null values.

nodes.summary: Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.
nodes.instructions:
An open or read error exits 1 with nothing on standard output and one stderr diagnostic naming
the file.
nodes.name: Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.

nodes.summary: Count rows, nulls, and distinct non-null values per column.
nodes.instructions:
rows is the number of data records, nulls the number of null values, distinct the number of
different non-null values compared as exact trimmed strings.
nodes.name: Count rows, nulls, and distinct non-null values per column.

nodes.summary: Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records with exit 3.
nodes.instructions:
Exit 3, write nothing to standard output, and write one diagnostic naming the file and the line
of a rejected record to standard error.
nodes.name: Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records with exit 3.

nodes.summary: Parse --column, --freq, --top, and the single file argument.
nodes.instructions:
Options precede exactly one file argument. --top defaults to 5. Parsing yields a request value
that the profile and frequency stories consume.
nodes.name: Parse --column, --freq, --top, and the single file argument.

nodes.summary: Profile only the column named by --column, rejecting an absent name with exit 3.
nodes.instructions:
Match trimmed header names exactly and case-sensitively. A name absent from the header exits 3
with nothing on standard output.
nodes.name: Profile only the column named by --column, rejecting an absent name with exit 3.

nodes.summary: Reject usage errors with exit 2 and both synopses on standard error.
nodes.instructions:
Exit 2 with nothing on standard output for a missing or extra file, an unknown option (including
--help and -h), a missing option value, a --top that is not a positive integer, --top without
--freq, and --column with --freq. Write both synopses to standard error.
nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit 2 and both synopses on standard error.

nodes.summary: Infer integer, number, boolean, text, and empty column types.
nodes.instructions:
A column takes the first matching type among integer, number, date, boolean, text that every
non-null value satisfies; a column with no non-null value is empty. Boolean ignores case. The date
check is supplied by the date-type story and is a hook that defaults to no match here.
nodes.name: Infer integer, number, boolean, text, and empty column types.

nodes.summary: Recognize date columns with real calendar validation.
nodes.instructions:
A value is a date only when it matches YYYY-MM-DD and is a real calendar date, so 2025-02-30 is
not. One non-date value makes the column fall to the next matching type.
nodes.name: Recognize date columns with real calendar validation.

nodes.summary: List the most frequent non-null values of a column with --freq.
nodes.instructions:
Order by count descending, then value ascending by byte value, at most --top rows (default 5).
Null values are not listed. A column with no non-null values writes only the header. An absent
column name exits 3.
nodes.name: List the most frequent non-null values of a column with --freq.

nodes.summary: Compute min and max per column type.
nodes.instructions:
Integer: smallest and largest as integers. Number: decimals with two places. Date: earliest and
latest. Boolean: min is false if any value is false; max is true if any value is true. Text: byte
order. Empty: blank. Compute with exact arithmetic, never floats.
nodes.name: Compute min and max per column type.

nodes.summary: Compute exact sum, mean, and median for integer and number columns.
nodes.instructions:
Use math/big exact values and round once, half away from zero, when writing. Integer sum is a
plain integer; number sum is two places; mean and median are two places for both types. Median is
the middle value, or the mean of the two middle values for an even count. Other types leave these
fields empty.
nodes.name: Compute exact sum, mean, and median for integer and number columns.

nodes.summary: Write profile and frequency output as CSV with newline line endings.
nodes.instructions:
Profile header is column,type,rows,nulls,distinct,min,max,sum,mean,median, one row per column in
file order. Frequency header is value,count. Use encoding/csv with UseCRLF false. A failing
command writes nothing to standard output, so buffer output and write only on success.
nodes.name: Write profile and frequency output as CSV with newline line endings.

nodes.summary: Provide bin/test.sh running go vet and go test from the application root.
nodes.instructions:
Write bin/test.sh in POSIX sh. It changes to the application root, runs go vet ./... then
go test ./..., and exits zero only when both pass.
nodes.name: Provide bin/test.sh running go vet and go test from the application root.

nodes.summary: Read a UTF-8 RFC 4180 file with encoding/csv into a header and data records.
nodes.instructions:
The first record is the header. Quoted commas stay in one value. Bytes that are not valid UTF-8
are not a rejection condition. Do not enable encoding/csv field-count checking here; ragged
detection is a separate story.

nodes.summary: Trim header names and values and classify null values.
nodes.instructions:
Trim leading and trailing spaces from every header name and value before any other rule. A value
is null when empty or equal to NA, N/A, or NULL ignoring case.
nodes.name: Trim header names and values and classify null values.

nodes.summary: Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.
nodes.instructions:
An open or read error exits 1 with nothing on standard output and one stderr diagnostic naming
the file.
nodes.name: Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.

nodes.summary: Count rows, nulls, and distinct non-null values per column.
nodes.instructions:
rows is the number of data records, nulls the number of null values, distinct the number of
different non-null values compared as exact trimmed strings.
nodes.name: Count rows, nulls, and distinct non-null values per column.

nodes.summary: Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records with exit 3.
nodes.instructions:
Exit 3, write nothing to standard output, and write one diagnostic naming the file and the line
of a rejected record to standard error.
nodes.name: Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records with exit 3.

nodes.summary: Parse --column, --freq, --top, and the single file argument.
nodes.instructions:
Options precede exactly one file argument. --top defaults to 5. Parsing yields a request value
that the profile and frequency stories consume.
nodes.name: Parse --column, --freq, --top, and the single file argument.

nodes.summary: Profile only the column named by --column, rejecting an absent name with exit 3.
nodes.instructions:
Match trimmed header names exactly and case-sensitively. A name absent from the header exits 3
with nothing on standard output.
nodes.name: Profile only the column named by --column, rejecting an absent name with exit 3.

nodes.summary: Reject usage errors with exit 2 and both synopses on standard error.
nodes.instructions:
Exit 2 with nothing on standard output for a missing or extra file, an unknown option (including
--help and -h), a missing option value, a --top that is not a positive integer, --top without
--freq, and --column with --freq. Write both synopses to standard error.
nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit 2 and both synopses on standard error.

nodes.summary: Infer integer, number, boolean, text, and empty column types.
nodes.instructions:
A column takes the first matching type among integer, number, date, boolean, text that every
non-null value satisfies; a column with no non-null value is empty. Boolean ignores case. The date
check is supplied by the date-type story and is a hook that defaults to no match here.
nodes.name: Infer integer, number, boolean, text, and empty column types.

nodes.summary: Recognize date columns with real calendar validation.
nodes.instructions:
A value is a date only when it matches YYYY-MM-DD and is a real calendar date, so 2025-02-30 is
not. One non-date value makes the column fall to the next matching type.
nodes.name: Recognize date columns with real calendar validation.

nodes.summary: List the most frequent non-null values of a column with --freq.
nodes.instructions:
Order by count descending, then value ascending by byte value, at most --top rows (default 5).
Null values are not listed. A column with no non-null values writes only the header. An absent
column name exits 3.
nodes.name: List the most frequent non-null values of a column with --freq.

nodes.summary: Compute min and max per column type.
nodes.instructions:
Integer: smallest and largest as integers. Number: decimals with two places. Date: earliest and
latest. Boolean: min is false if any value is false; max is true if any value is true. Text: byte
order. Empty: blank. Compute with exact arithmetic, never floats.
nodes.name: Compute min and max per column type.
